user.title: Home PV Control
user.description: Set up HPVC. The integration creates its Home Assistant entities and sidebar dashboard natively. It can also install/update the bundled HPVC Node-RED flow through the official Node-RED Admin API. Leave the Node-RED URL empty to discover the Home Assistant Node-RED add-on. Automatic writes are opt-in.

legacy_migration.title: Legacy HPVC installation detected
legacy_migration.description: HPVC found {count} legacy/manual HPVC helper entities. Continue setup to enter protected migration mode. After the integration is added, open Home PV Control from the sidebar and use **Delete legacy HPVC helpers & migrate**. Nothing is deleted until you explicitly confirm the cleanup there.

init.title: HPVC Node-RED settings
init.description: Configure the Node-RED Admin API connection used for HPVC flow installation and updates. Leave the URL empty to discover the Home Assistant Node-RED add-on. For external Node-RED, configure an existing Home Assistant server in Node-RED first.
